_readme: ROSETTA DICTIONARY for type LowCostHouse, authored IN HINDSIGHT from TBKLTN_House.pdf (owner 2026-11-03: 'a Rosetta Stone dictionary you can infer in hindsight'). Source = multimodal read of the sheets (accepted by owner); each entry carries a `check` naming the numeric witness that corroborates it, or null.

grid.check: rosetta_verify.py G1: label centres in text layer vs read dims

room_tag_format: 2x2 box under the room name: [FFL from AGL | floor area sqm] over [floor finish | wall finish]
room_class_note: room x/y rectangles are grid-to-grid NOMINAL cells (area = dx*dy); check = rosetta_verify.py R1 vs printed_sqm

notes_G._meaning: G1..G10 in a triangle = general-note tags keyed to the table on p3; text layer holds only the tag, the note text is drawn
notes_G.G1: R.C beams, ground slabs & footing to Engr's detail
notes_G.G2: soil pipe discharged to IST per manufacturer's spec, Engr's detail and SPAN approval
notes_G.G5: 230 mm dia half p.c. PERIMETER DRAIN discharged to nearest road-side drain, Engr's detail
notes_G.G6: location of 250 gal HDPE water tank on H.W plinth, Engr's + SPAN approval
notes_G.G7: dotted lines = waterproofing up to 1500 mm ht (baths)
notes_G.G9: 50 dia uPVC vent pipe with wire ball mesh built up 300 high above roof surface
notes_G.G10: 50 mm thk x 600 mm d r.c. working counter top, cement render finish
notes_G.anomaly: p7 tags the water tank with G10 while p3 defines G6 as the tank and G10 as the counter top — drafter inconsistency, kept yellow

roof.finish: MR metal roofing on prefabricated trusses incl. fascia board (+ FG GI flashing)
roof.layout: main gable, ridge along grid 3 (E-W) with two 25 deg faces; porch (ANJUNG) gable with N-S ridge meeting it; plan tags MR, HC, BC, VT read but not decoded

perimeter_drain.geometry: nested outer outline around the L-shaped footprint incl. porch, DISCHARGE arrows mid-side (N,S,W,E), manhole MH1 (G4) NW outside
perimeter_drain.check: gap of the nested lines measured but NOT matching 230 mm (candidates 276 / 176 mm) -> YELLOW

sheets_read.p1: 1. FLOOR PLAN (+ finishes key, symbols table)
sheets_read.p3: 3. ROOF PLAN (+ G1-G10 note table); title block says '1. REFL. CEILING PLAN' (inconsistent)
sheets_read.p7: 11. DIAGRAMMATIC COLD WATER LAYOUT + 10. DIAGRAMMATIC SANITARY LAYOUT (NTS)

opening_drawing_conventions.window: chain of 100x500 mm closed rects at 600 mm pitch along a wall axis; width = modules x 600 (W3 1, W2 2, W1 3)
opening_drawing_conventions.door: quarter-circle swing arc, radius = nominal width minus ~80 mm (frame), cubic Bezier endpoints span r x r

library_binding._note: opening tag -> family_id of the LOCAL LOD400 library (BIMCompiler component_library.db, exported by export_library_subset.js --full; Duplex items). exact=false = nearest-size STAND-IN (owner 2026-11-04: 'use from Duplex items'); the library holds no window of the drawing's sizes. Ratios are of default_width x default_height.

D1.note: exact size WITH mesh (Terminal FD1) once migration CL006 gives the family a size pair (§27); fire-rated institutional door standing in for an unrated house door: semantics YELLOW

D2.note: exact size WITH mesh (Terminal FD1) once migration CL006 gives the family a size pair (§27); fire-rated institutional door standing in for an unrated house door: semantics YELLOW

D3.note: exact size WITH mesh (Terminal FD1) once migration CL006 gives the family a size pair (§27); fire-rated institutional door standing in for an unrated house door: semantics YELLOW

W2.note: stand-in. Rejected before: LARGE_WINDOW (no mesh/size pair in its description -> LOD400 HARD FAIL), DUPLEX_SKYLIGHT (closest size but a horizontal skylight mesh -> the lane's own GAP:lod400_orientation refuses it). DUPLEX_CASEMENT = nearest-size VERTICAL window with geometry.
